_about: The faction catalogue import (verify/from-bsdata.js tyranids) reads BSData's whole Tyranids catalogue through verify/from-json.js as the export catalog-tyranids; this is its hand file. weaponNames: a weapon BSData names otherwise than GW's datasheet (Wahapedia) by more than verify/from-json.js's spelling rules can tell, so that GW's profile is found and its values checked; the app keeps BSData's name (New Recruit's, which the lists' signed-off rows and the in-app import use). profileNames: the same for a model profile. modelNames: a model (stats row) BSData misprints (typo: GW's name, declared) or names otherwise (kept, listed). fixes: GW's words where Wahapedia's transcription of a detachment differs ({ at:"<detachment>/<kind>/<name>", field, from, to, why }, exactly once), as for a list (verify/from-json.js).

fixes.why: Wahapedia closes the bracket with "]"; GW's Faction Pack Tyranids (Rules Updates: Unending Swarm Detachment, Synaptic Goading Stratagem, When and Effect Sections) prints "(instead of as close as possible to the closest enemy unit)."

tyranids/the-red-terror.why: GW's Faction Pack Tyranids prints The Red Terror's datasheet with "KEYWORDS: Character, Mobile, Epic Hero, Great Devourer, Monster, Burrower, Vanguard Invader, The Red Terror" (verify/.cache/gw/eng_14-10_wh40k_faction_pack_tyranids-an12izciwp-np2hnkcsje.txt lines 305-306): BURROWER, not BSData's category "Burrowers" as well
